author: TechVlogIndia
text: Zepto delivery is really 10 mins in Mumbai, but in Bangalore it takes 25-30 mins during peak office hours. Blinkit is much more consistent in Bangalore.

author: RohanSharma
text: The delivery boy marked my order as 'Open Box Completed' without even showing me the items. When I checked, the milk packet was leaking and support refused a refund saying OTP was shared. Total scam!

author: Priya_K
text: Honestly, Swiggy Instamart packaging is the best. Zepto just puts everything in one paper bag, sometimes my soft fruits get crushed under heavy detergent bottles.

author: KumarS
text: Their search is very bad. If I search for a specific biscuit brand, it shows 10 sponsored brands first. Very annoying discovery experience.

author: ParentCare99
text: I buy my daily groceries and household cleaning supplies on Zepto, but I never buy baby products like diapers or baby food here. They throw the diaper packs in the same bag as phenyl and washing powders, which smells chemical. Swiggy Instamart packages baby essentials separately and feels much more sanitary.

author: PetLoverDel
text: Why doesn't Zepto offer any options in dog food? Every time I search for Pedigree or organic dog treats, they show 'Out of stock' or suggest unrelated human biscuits. I buy dog food in bulk on Amazon instead. If they had a pet care category with trustable brands, I would order it instantly.

author: FitnessFreakPrakash
text: I used to only buy late-night cold drinks and chips on Zepto, but recently I noticed their fitness section. I ordered organic almond milk and high-protein sugar-free snacks. It's a lifesaver for my diet when I have midnight cravings, but they need to show the expiry date on these protein supplements because they are expensive!

author: RoutineShopperAnjali
text: The app has a major echo chamber problem. I buy milk, curd, and bread every single day. Now, my entire homepage is just milk and bread. I didn't even know Zepto sells personal care products like organic face washes and moisturizers until a friend told me! The homepage recommendations are completely useless for discovering new categories.

author: UrgentBuyerAmit
text: Yesterday night my son had a sudden fever at 11 PM. I ordered paracetamol and a thermometer on Zepto's medicine category. It got delivered in 9 minutes. This emergency SOS service is amazing, but for regular wellness products I still go to the local pharmacy because it's cheaper.
